title.en: An Act Converting the Sitios of Lantawan and Kalasagan in the Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao, Into a Barrio, to Be Known as the Barrio of Lantawan of the Same Municipality
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitios of Lantawan and Kalasagan in the Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao, Into a Barrio, to Be Known as the Barrio of Lantawan of the Same Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Lantawan và Kalasagan tại Thị trấn Lupon, Tỉnh Davao thành Barrio với tên gọi Barrio Lantawan của thị trấn nói trên
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Lantawan และ Kalasagan ในเทศบาล Lupon จังหวัด Davao เป็น บาริโอในชื่อบาริโอ Lantawan ของเทศบาลดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Lantawan dan Kalasagan di Kotamadya Lupon, Provinsi Davao menjadi Barrio dengan nama Barrio Lantawan dari kotamadya tersebut
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Lantawan dan Kalasagan di Perbandaran Lupon, Wilayah Davao kepada Barrio dengan nama Barrio Lantawan daripada perbandaran tersebut

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5563_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Lantawan and Kalasagan in the Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao, are hereby converted into a barrio to be known as Barrio Lantawan of the same municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
